pros: Long shelf life due to UHT treatment

trustedSourceSummary: No official consumer documents were found in the last 60 days, so the latest available official sources from 2025-2026 were used. Organizations used: Altroconsumo. Altroconsumo’s 2025 laboratory test of 16 UHT milk brands highlighted ARBOREA and CARREFOUR CLASSIC as top picks, citing superior taste, quality composition, and long shelf life. The evidence is fresh (published 2025‑04‑22).
